description: User-requested USB-C and ATTEND 226A-1202 OBD-II connector revisions; upstream V240 PDF remains unchanged.
usb_role: USB 2.0 full-speed device / 5 V sink using the existing CP2102 and power path

J2.package_note: 16-contact USB 2.0 receptacle; standard 0.95 mm shell stakes; KiCad footprint checked against GCT USB4105 drawing revision B4.

R102.package_note: 5.1 kohm, 1%, 0603, CC1-to-GND Rd termination; independent from CC2.

R103.package_note: 5.1 kohm, 1%, 0603, CC2-to-GND Rd termination; independent from CC1.

J1.package_note: Manufacturer drawing rev 2: 4 mm pitch, 3 mm tail-row spacing, 1.35 mm drills, 2.35 mm pads. Pin 1 upper-left, mating face left. PCB edge moved 0.15 mm outward relative to recommended layout for 0.325 mm copper clearance.

J2.reason: Expanded-board spacing; critical pin-distance pairs preserved as rigid clusters

R102.reason: First placement pass: local net spans, feedback/loop and bypass proximity; connector/RF/mechanical anchors retained

R103.reason: First placement pass: local net spans, feedback/loop and bypass proximity; connector/RF/mechanical anchors retained

U11.reason: First placement pass: local net spans, feedback/loop and bypass proximity; connector/RF/mechanical anchors retained

J1.reason: ATTEND 226A-1202 rev 2 tail pattern; 0.15 mm inward offset improves pad-to-edge clearance to 0.325 mm; manufacturer CAD board/hardware clearance checked

routing_notes: Join A6/B6 to D+ and A7/B7 to D- near J2, then route through U11 to the CP2102. Keep the duplicate-pad stubs short.
CC1 and CC2 each have their own 5.1 kohm Rd. Do not short them together.
Connect all four VBUS contacts to the existing VBUS net, all four ground contacts and shell stakes to GND. SBU1/SBU2 remain NC.
The connector change does not add USB-PD, higher-voltage input or USB 3.x capability. Default USB current and existing power protection require review with the complete circuit.
Preserve the existing U11 data-line protection; review additional CC/VBUS ESD protection and USB input-current limits before fabrication. The board remains unrouted.
USB-C SMD pad mask expansion is 0.025 mm per side, leaving a 0.15 mm mask bridge at the 0.5 mm-pitch, 0.3 mm-wide contact row with the planned black mask.
